fieldData.hero-intro: Your essential guide to key deliverables, team preparation, business meetings, travel, and everything you need for a smooth, successful onsite experience.
fieldData.welcome-title: Welcome, we’re excited to see you soon!
fieldData.welcome-intro: Everything you need to prepare, travel, and arrive ready is gathered here in one focused guide, making the weeks before the Institute feel clear, organized, and manageable.
fieldData.welcome-body:
Welcome to the 2027 EHS Management Institute—an exclusive opportunity to connect with senior EHS executives, gain valuable industry insights, and build meaningful business relationships.

To help you maximize your experience and ensure a successful event, there are a few important pre-event steps to complete in the weeks ahead. This guide outlines everything you need to know, including key deadlines, deliverables, and event details.

Your Operations Lead, Tori Di Clemente, will be available throughout the planning process to answer questions, provide support, and ensure you are fully prepared for a productive and successful event experience.
fieldData.preparation-title: Preparing for your Institute is as easy as 1-2-3.
fieldData.preparation-intro: Complete these Sponsor Hub deliverables so your onsite team and meeting strategy are ready well before arrival.
fieldData.key-dates-intro: Company, attendee, and business-meeting milestones—sequenced from profiling through arrival.
fieldData.agenda-intro: Times are approximate and subject to change. Please refer to the Event Agenda in the Sponsor Hub for complete program details.
fieldData.hub-body:
The Sponsor Hub is the central resource for managing your organization’s participation in the event. Through the Hub, you can submit a custom Delegate Profiling Question, update your company information, register your onsite attendees, complete the business meeting selection process, review key dates and deliverables, and access important event information and resources.

Sponsor Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks prior to the event start date.
fieldData.experience-intro: Business meetings are pre-scheduled based on the priorities and preferences submitted by both Service Providers and attending executives.
fieldData.support-title: Sponsor Support Lives in the Hub.
fieldData.support-body: Visit the Sponsor Hub for a comprehensive FAQ section covering a wide range of topics, including pre-event deliverables, hotel reservations, business meetings, shipping instructions, onsite logistics, and post-event follow-up details.
fieldData.contact-title: Questions Before You Go? We’re Here to Help.
fieldData.contact-intro: Reach out for help with the Sponsor Hub, attendee registrations, deliverables, hotel details, or meeting selections.
fieldData.name: EHS Jan 2027 Sponsor

fieldData.welcome-body:
Welcome to the 2027 EHS Management Institute, and thank you for choosing to join us. We are delighted to bring together an exceptional group of senior Healthcare HR leaders and solution providers for three days of meaningful conversations, fresh perspectives, and valuable relationship-building opportunities.

In the coming weeks, we will guide you through three simple steps to help prepare for a successful program. Your Operations Lead, Tori Di Clemente, will be available throughout the process to provide support and ensure you are ready to make the most of your experience.
fieldData.preparation-title: Preparing for your Institute is as easy as 1-2-3.
fieldData.preparation-intro: Complete these actions in the Attendee Hub, then build a schedule around the conversations that matter most to you.
fieldData.key-dates-intro: Your profile, hotel, and schedule milestones—sequenced from first login through arrival.
fieldData.agenda-intro: Times are approximate and subject to change. Please refer to the Event Agenda in the Sponsor Hub for complete program details.
fieldData.hub-body:
The Attendee Hub is your central resource for all event-related information. Through the Hub, you can review key dates and deliverables, submit your Attendee Profile questionnaire and hotel requirements, build your personalized itinerary, and access important event information and resources.

Attendee Hub login credentials are provided by your Operations Lead in their welcome email, which is typically sent 8–10 weeks before the event start date.
fieldData.experience-intro: A purposeful mix of insight, one-to-one conversation, and peer collaboration.
fieldData.contact-title: Questions Before You Go? We’re Here to Help.
fieldData.contact-intro: Reach out for help with your Attendee Hub, hotel details, profile, or personal schedule.
